description: This Java class 'BreadcrumbsUtils' provides utility methods for building breadcrumb navigation data structures for categories and products in a web application. It constructs breadcrumb trails based on category lineage, product references, and store context, integrating with category services and message utilities.

classes.name: BreadcrumbsUtils
classes.description: Utility class for constructing breadcrumb data structures for categories and products.

methods.name: buildCategoryBreadcrumb
methods.description: Builds a breadcrumb trail based on a clicked category, store, language, and context path.

methods.name: buildProductBreadcrumb
methods.description: Builds a breadcrumb trail for a product, including its category lineage and product information.

methods.name: parseBreadCrumb
methods.description: Parses breadcrumb reference content string to extract category IDs.

methods.name: parseCategoryLineage
methods.description: Parses a category lineage string into a list of category IDs.

methods.name: buildBreadCrumb
methods.description: Constructs breadcrumb string from a list of category IDs.
